categories.name: Bug Fixes
categories.description: Bugs and gaps found during verification

phases.name: Foundation
phases.description: Core setup, types, database, basic UI

features.title: Monorepo scaffold with Turborepo
features.description: Initialize monorepo structure with Turborepo for build orchestration. Setup apps/web, apps/server, apps/desktop, packages/types, packages/db directories with proper tsconfig paths.
acceptanceCriteria: turbo.json configured with build, dev, check pipelines
Package workspaces defined in root package.json
bun run dev starts all apps concurrently

features.title: Shared types package with branded types
features.description: Create packages/types with branded types for FeatureId, ProjectId, SessionId using Zod. Export type inference utilities and shared constants.
acceptanceCriteria: Branded types prevent mixing IDs at compile time

features.title: Feature Zod schema with validation
features.description: Define Feature Zod schema matching feature.schema.json. Include all fields: id, title, category, description, status, passes, acceptanceCriteria, dependencies.

features.title: Project Zod schema with validation
features.description: Define Project Zod schema for multi-project support. Include name, path, settings, createdAt, updatedAt fields with proper validation.
features.failureReason: swarm_audit: test fixtures use wrong ID format (proj-001 vs P[0-9]{3}), 14+ tests should be failing (SW-001)
features.verificationNote: Verified: ProjectSchema exists in packages/types/src/project.ts with validation

features.title: Session Zod schema for agent sessions
features.description: Define Session Zod schema for tracking agent execution sessions. Include sessionId, featureId, status, startedAt, completedAt, output fields.

features.title: Database package with Drizzle ORM
features.description: Setup packages/db with Drizzle ORM and SQLite (libSQL). Configure drizzle.config.ts, create initial schema file, setup migration system.

features.title: Projects table schema
features.description: Create Drizzle schema for projects table with id, name, path, settings (JSON), createdAt, updatedAt columns. Add indexes for name lookup.

features.title: Features table schema
features.description: Create Drizzle schema for features table mirroring feature.schema.json. Include all fields with proper SQLite types, foreign key to projects.
acceptanceCriteria: All feature fields mapped to columns

features.title: Sessions table schema
features.description: Create Drizzle schema for sessions table tracking agent executions. Include foreign keys to features and projects, output storage.

features.title: Learning table schema
features.description: Create Drizzle schema for learnings table storing patterns extracted from feature implementations. Include category, pattern, antiPattern, context fields.

features.title: Database migrations initial setup
features.description: Generate and run initial migrations for all tables. Setup migration runner in server startup, handle schema versioning.

features.title: Repository pattern for projects
features.description: Implement ProjectRepository with CRUD operations using Drizzle. Include findAll, findById, create, update, delete methods with proper typing.

features.title: Repository pattern for features
features.description: Implement FeatureRepository with CRUD and query operations. Include findByProject, findByStatus, updateStatus, bulk operations.

features.title: Repository pattern for sessions
features.description: Implement SessionRepository for agent session tracking. Include create, update, findByFeature, findActive methods.

features.title: Hono server setup with oRPC
features.description: Setup apps/server with Hono framework and oRPC for type-safe APIs. Configure middleware stack, CORS, error handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Hono server starts on configured port

features.title: Health check endpoint
features.description: Implement /health endpoint returning server status, database connection, and version info. Used by Tauri to verify backend is running.

features.title: Projects oRPC router
features.description: Implement oRPC router for project CRUD operations. Include list, get, create, update, delete procedures with Zod validation.

features.title: Features oRPC router
features.description: Implement oRPC router for feature operations. Include list, get, create, update, delete, updateStatus, bulkUpdate procedures.

features.title: Sessions oRPC router
features.description: Implement oRPC router for session operations. Include create, get, list, updateStatus procedures for agent session tracking.
features.failureReason: swarm_audit: 8/10 session router endpoints lack userId authorization (SW-010)
features.verificationNote: Verified: Session oRPC router exists in packages/api/src/routers/session.ts

features.title: React app with TanStack Router
features.description: Setup apps/web with React 19, Vite 6, TanStack Router. Configure routes for dashboard, project, feature detail pages.

features.title: Tailwind CSS 4 setup with shadcn/ui
features.description: Configure Tailwind CSS 4 with shadcn/ui component library. Setup theme tokens, dark mode support, component directory structure.

features.title: Zustand store for global state
features.description: Setup Zustand store for application state. Create slices for projects, features, sessions, UI state with proper typing.

features.title: TanStack Query setup for API calls
features.description: Configure TanStack Query with oRPC client. Setup query keys, default options, error handling, optimistic updates.

features.title: App layout with sidebar navigation
features.description: Create main app layout with collapsible sidebar, header, and content area. Include project selector, navigation links, user menu.

features.title: Kanban board component
features.description: Create Kanban board with columns for each status (backlog, in_progress, waiting_approval, verified). Use dnd-kit for drag-drop.

features.title: Feature card component
features.description: Create feature card showing id, title, priority badge, size indicator, dependency count. Compact view for Kanban column.

features.title: Feature detail panel
features.description: Create slide-out panel for feature details. Show all fields, acceptance criteria checklist, dependencies graph, action buttons.

features.title: Feature create/edit form
features.description: Create form for adding/editing features using TanStack Form. Validate with Zod schema, handle acceptance criteria array.

features.title: Kanban column header with count
features.description: Create column header showing status name, feature count, optional actions menu. Include collapse/expand toggle.

features.title: Kanban filters and search
features.description: Add filter bar above Kanban with search, category filter, phase filter, priority filter. Persist filter state.

features.title: Claude Agent SDK client setup
features.description: Setup @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk in server. Configure API client, model selection, tool permissions, environment variables.
features.failureReason: swarm_audit: ClaudeProvider hardcodes bypassPermissions:true, overrides user config (SW-009)

features.title: Agent session creation service
features.description: Implement AgentService.createSession() to initialize Claude agent with feature context, system prompt, and tool configuration.
features.failureReason: swarm_audit: agent sendMessage has no session ownership check (SW-011)

features.title: Agent execution with streaming
features.description: Implement agent execution with streaming output. Capture text, tool calls, tool results, and thinking tokens in real-time.

features.title: WebSocket server for real-time events
features.description: Setup WebSocket server in Hono for real-time event streaming. Handle connections, authentication, message routing.
features.failureReason: swarm_audit: WebSocket accepts anonymous connections, broadcasts all events to all clients (SW-003)
features.verificationNote: Verified: WebSocket in event-broadcaster.ts with connection auth

features.title: Agent output WebSocket streaming
features.description: Stream agent output to connected clients via WebSocket. Emit events for text chunks, tool calls, completion, errors.
features.verificationNote: Verified: Streaming via event-broadcaster.ts and pipeline-service.ts

features.title: Agent output viewer component
features.description: Create React component to display streaming agent output. Show markdown formatted text, collapsible tool calls, thinking indicator.

features.title: Tool call visualization
features.description: Create component to display tool calls with name, input, output, duration. Color-code by tool type, show file diffs.

features.title: Start feature execution button
features.description: Add button to feature detail to start agent execution. Show confirmation dialog with options for model, thinking level, planning mode.

features.title: Stop feature execution
features.description: Add ability to stop running agent execution. Send cancel signal, cleanup resources, update session status.

features.title: Fix: entity IDs use randomUUID instead of branded format (F###, P###, S###)
features.description: crypto.randomUUID() used for entity IDs instead of branded format (F###, P###, S###). Suggested fix: Implement branded ID generation: query max(id), increment, format with prefix
acceptanceCriteria: Branded ID generation (F###, P###, S###) replaces crypto.randomUUID()
Existing entities remain accessible after migration

features.title: Fix: bulkUpdateStatus validates then updates without transaction wrapping
features.description: bulkUpdateStatus validates then updates without transaction wrapping. Suggested fix: Wrap validation + update in featureRepository.withTransaction()
acceptanceCriteria: bulkUpdateStatus wraps validation + update in a single transaction

features.title: Fix: Projects table missing status column defined in ProjectSchema Zod type
features.description: Projects table missing status column defined in ProjectSchema Zod type. Suggested fix: Add status text column + migration
acceptanceCriteria: Projects table includes status column matching ProjectSchema Zod type

features.title: Fix: No userId/ownerId column — any auth user can CRUD any entity
features.description: No userId/ownerId column — any auth user can CRUD any entity. Suggested fix: Add userId columns, enforce ownership in all repository methods
acceptanceCriteria: Users can only CRUD their own entities
features.failureReason: swarm_audit: userId authorization only enforced in 2/9 routers — fix incomplete (SW-002)
features.verificationNote: Verified: userId column on all entities (projects, features, sessions, learnings, api-keys)

features.title: Fix: No rate limiting on any routes
features.description: No rate limiting on any routes. Suggested fix: Add hono-rate-limiter middleware
acceptanceCriteria: Rate limiting middleware active on all routes

features.title: Fix: F031 SDK client needs error handling and retry logic
features.description: F031 Claude Agent SDK client is verified but lacks robust error handling, retry logic, and connection timeout configuration. Originally flagged when F031 was in_progress with no code.
acceptanceCriteria: SDK client has error handling for API failures
Retry logic with exponential backoff configured

features.title: Fix: F032 agent service needs input validation and limits
features.description: F032 agent session creation service is verified but lacks input validation for session parameters and resource limits. Originally flagged when F032 was in_progress with no code.
acceptanceCriteria: Session creation validates all input parameters
Resource limits prevent unbounded session creation
Invalid inputs return clear error messages

features.title: Fix: F033 in_progress but no streaming implementation exists
features.description: F033 in_progress but no streaming implementation exists. Suggested fix: Update status to pending or implement streaming
acceptanceCriteria: Streaming implementation exists for agent execution
Server-sent events or WebSocket delivers output chunks

features.title: Fix: F011 AC 'Rollback capability exists' — no rollback mechanism
features.description: F011 AC 'Rollback capability exists' — no rollback mechanism. Suggested fix: Document rollback strategy or implement manual rollback

features.title: Fix: F001 AC 'TypeScript project references working' — no references configured
features.description: F001 AC 'TypeScript project references working' — no references configured. Suggested fix: Add references array to root tsconfig.json
acceptanceCriteria: TypeScript project references configured in tsconfig.json
Cross-package type checking works via references

features.title: Fix: bulkUpdateStatus silently skips non-existent feature IDs
features.description: bulkUpdateStatus silently skips non-existent feature IDs. Suggested fix: Collect missing IDs and throw ORPCError NOT_FOUND
acceptanceCriteria: bulkUpdateStatus returns error for non-existent feature IDs
No silent skips on invalid IDs

features.title: Fix: DB stores {} for settings, Zod expects undefined to apply defaults
features.description: DB stores {} for settings, Zod expects undefined to apply defaults. Suggested fix: Handle empty object in Zod transform
acceptanceCriteria: DB default for settings compatible with Zod schema defaults
Empty settings object applies Zod defaults correctly

features.title: Fix: VALID_TRANSITIONS duplicated in 4 files
features.description: VALID_TRANSITIONS duplicated in 4 files. Suggested fix: Extract to @nomos-ai/types as centralized constant
acceptanceCriteria: VALID_TRANSITIONS defined in single source of truth
All 4 files import from shared location

features.title: Fix: No X-Frame-Options, CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options
features.description: No X-Frame-Options, CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options. Suggested fix: Add Hono secureHeaders middleware
acceptanceCriteria: X-Frame-Options, CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options headers set

features.title: Fix: sameSite:none disables CSRF, secure:true breaks dev
features.description: sameSite:none disables CSRF, secure:true breaks dev. Suggested fix: Make cookie settings environment-aware
acceptanceCriteria: secure flag respects NODE_ENV for dev/prod

features.title: Fix: Error handlers expose internal details to clients
features.description: Error handlers expose internal details to clients. Suggested fix: Sanitize error messages in production
acceptanceCriteria: Error responses return generic messages to clients

features.title: Fix: CATEGORIES, PHASES, SIZES hardcoded instead of imported from types
features.description: CATEGORIES, PHASES, SIZES hardcoded instead of imported from types. Suggested fix: Export arrays from types package, import in components
acceptanceCriteria: No hardcoded duplicates in component files

features.title: Fix: Identical try-catch error pattern duplicated 15+ times
features.description: Identical try-catch error pattern duplicated 15+ times. Suggested fix: Create handleRepositoryError utility
acceptanceCriteria: Shared error handler replaces 15+ identical try-catch blocks

features.title: Fix: ID generation in router handlers — should be in repository layer
features.description: ID generation in router handlers — should be in repository layer. Suggested fix: Move ID generation into repository create methods
acceptanceCriteria: ID generation moved to repository layer
Router handlers no longer generate IDs directly

features.title: Fix: Status colors + display metadata duplicated across components
features.description: Status colors + display metadata duplicated across components. Suggested fix: Create shared FEATURE_STATUS_METADATA constant
acceptanceCriteria: Status colors and display metadata in single shared module
All components import from shared source

features.title: Fix: Dark mode toggle exists but no Tailwind 4 theme tokens defined
features.description: Dark mode toggle exists but no Tailwind 4 theme tokens defined. Suggested fix: Add Tailwind 4 CSS variables for dark mode
acceptanceCriteria: Tailwind 4 theme tokens defined for dark/light modes
Dark mode toggle applies tokens correctly

features.title: Fix: Learning table exists but no repository implementation
features.description: Learning table exists but no repository implementation. Suggested fix: Create learningRepository with CRUD methods
acceptanceCriteria: CRUD operations work against learning table

features.title: Fix: No learning oRPC router — frontend can't query learnings
features.description: No learning oRPC router — frontend can't query learnings. Suggested fix: Create learning router + add to appRouter
acceptanceCriteria: Learning oRPC router exposes query endpoints
Frontend can fetch learnings via API
features.failureReason: swarm_audit: learning router no ownership checks (SW-004)
features.verificationNote: Verified: Learning router exists in packages/api/src/routers/learning.ts

features.title: Fix: Project status field in Zod but missing from DB table
features.description: Project status field in Zod but missing from DB table. Suggested fix: Add status column + migration (same as BUG-003)
acceptanceCriteria: Project status column in DB matches Zod schema
Migration adds column without data loss

features.title: Fix: Feature IDs generated as UUID, breaks F001-F999 pattern
features.description: Feature IDs generated as UUID, breaks F001-F999 pattern. Suggested fix: Generate sequential F### IDs (same as BUG-001)
acceptanceCriteria: Feature IDs follow F001-F999 branded format
New features get sequential branded IDs

features.title: Types + DB layer for Automaker mirror
features.description: Create new type modules (events, worktree, settings, message, notification, provider, pipeline, pagination) and Drizzle schemas. Extend feature.ts, session.ts, ids.ts with new fields. Add all repositories and migrations.
acceptanceCriteria: bun run check-types passes with zero errors
bun run db:generate creates migrations for all new/modified tables
All repository methods have proper TypeScript signatures
Branded ID types enforce type safety at compile time
features.technicalNotes: Reference: .nomos/inspiration/automaker-mirror/data-models.md for exact field mappings and Zod/Drizzle definitions.

features.title: Agent engine + WebSocket server
features.description: Implement ClaudeProvider wrapper, SDK options factory, EventService, EventBroadcaster, WebSocket server with Bun native upgrade for /ws/events. Rewrite AgentService for full session management with SDK streaming.
acceptanceCriteria: WebSocket connection to /ws/events succeeds with auth
Agent session can be created via oRPC
Sending a message invokes Claude SDK and streams response
Events are broadcast to connected WebSocket clients
SDK session ID is persisted for conversation resumption
features.technicalNotes: Reference: .nomos/inspiration/automaker-mirror/implementation-patterns.md sections 1-4 for provider, event, WebSocket, and agent patterns.

features.title: Autonomous loop + pipeline + worktree
features.description: Implement WorktreeService (git ops via Bun.spawn), PromptBuilder, PipelineService (7-step execution with checkpoint/resume), AutoModeService (feature loop, concurrency, failure tracking). Add worktree and auto-mode routers.
acceptanceCriteria: Auto-mode starts and emits auto-mode:started event
Picks next pending feature respecting dependency order
Creates git worktree for feature isolation
Runs 7-step pipeline with checkpoint/resume via DB
features.technicalNotes: Reference: .nomos/inspiration/automaker-mirror/implementation-patterns.md sections 5-6 for pipeline and worktree patterns.
features.failureReason: swarm_audit: auto-mode uses hardcoded userId auto-mode, sessions not tied to real users (SW-012)
features.verificationNote: Verified: AutoModeService, PipelineService, WorktreeService all implemented

features.title: Terminal service with WebSocket streaming
features.description: Implement TerminalService with Bun.spawn shell sessions, output buffering (4KB/4ms batching), 50KB scrollback. Add WebSocket handler for /ws/terminal with session routing. CRUD terminal router.
acceptanceCriteria: Input sent via WebSocket reaches shell process
Output is batched (4KB/4ms) to prevent flooding
features.technicalNotes: Reference: .nomos/inspiration/automaker-mirror/implementation-patterns.md section 7 for terminal pattern. Use Bun.spawn (not node-pty).
features.failureReason: swarm_audit: terminal router no user isolation (SW-003)

features.title: Settings + notifications + GitHub + FS services
features.description: Implement SettingsService (layered config: default/global/project), NotificationService (create/read/mark-read with events), GitHubService (gh CLI wrapper for issues/PRs), FSService (sandboxed file ops). All routers: settings, notifications, github, fs, models, events.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings save/load with layered resolution (default then global then project)
Notifications created on feature events and retrievable by project
GitHub service lists issues and PRs via gh CLI
FS service validates paths against allowed root preventing traversal
Models endpoint returns available Claude models
features.technicalNotes: Reference: .nomos/inspiration/automaker-mirror/implementation-patterns.md sections 8-9, 12-13 for settings, notification, GitHub, and FS patterns.
features.verificationNote: Verified: SettingsService, NotificationService, GitHubService, FSService all implemented

features.title: WebSocket client + agent chat view
features.description: Implement WebSocket client with auto-reconnect and exponential backoff. Create hooks (use-websocket, use-event-stream, use-agent-stream) and agent store. Build agent chat view with message list, tool-call display, streaming indicator, session sidebar.
acceptanceCriteria: WebSocket client auto-connects with backoff on failure
Real-time streaming of agent output with typing indicator
Tool calls display with name and input and result
Session sidebar shows history and allows switching
Messages persist across page reloads from DB via API
features.technicalNotes: Reference: .nomos/inspiration/automaker-mirror/architecture-map.md WebSocket section for client patterns. Use TanStack Router for /agent route.

features.title: Terminal view + diff viewer + enhanced kanban
features.description: Build terminal view with xterm.js and WebSocket integration, multi-session tabs, split panes. Implement diff viewer with side-by-side syntax highlighting. Enhance kanban with dnd-kit cross-column drag and sortable cards.
acceptanceCriteria: Terminal renders at /terminal route with xterm.js
Multi-session tabs allow switching between terminals
Diff viewer renders side-by-side with syntax highlighting
Kanban board supports cross-column drag-and-drop via dnd-kit
Feature cards show status and progress
features.technicalNotes: New deps: @xterm/xterm, @xterm/addon-fit, @xterm/addon-web-links, @dnd-kit/core, @dnd-kit/sortable, @dnd-kit/utilities, react-diff-viewer-continued. Lazy-load xterm on terminal route.

features.title: Settings UI + auto-mode dashboard + notifications + themes
features.description: Build settings pages with tabbed layout (general, model, auto-mode, terminal, integrations). Auto-mode dashboard with start/stop, queue, event feed, pipeline stepper. Notification bell and list. Theme system with 10+ themes via CSS variables.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings page with tabbed layout renders correctly
Settings persist via API with layered resolution
Auto-mode dashboard shows start/stop and active features and queue
Pipeline stepper visualizes 7-step progress per feature

Theme system applies 10+ themes via CSS variables

features.title: Add apps/web to root tsconfig references

acceptanceCriteria: Root tsconfig.json includes apps/web in references

features.title: Fix userId authorization in 7 remaining API routers

acceptanceCriteria: Session router: all 10 endpoints enforce userId ownership
Agent router: all 6 endpoints enforce userId ownership

Notifications router: all 5 endpoints scoped to userId
Worktree router: all 4 endpoints enforce userId checks

features.title: Fix WebSocket authentication — reject anonymous connections

acceptanceCriteria: WebSocket rejects connection when auth fails (no anonymous fallback)

features.title: Fix ClaudeProvider bypassPermissions override

acceptanceCriteria: bypassPermissions only used when explicitly configured
